summary: SPX/NDX/RUT rose on an in-line July CPI (+3.4% YoY) and blockbuster AI-infrastructure earnings (CoreWeave +19.28%, Super Micro +19.02%, Lumentum +13.63%). Hardware led while software bled (AppLovin -4.68%, Workday, Meta) in a clean intra-AI rotation. NDX flagged Neutral Bear despite +0.74%. Smart Money split between an entrenched hard-asset complex (mining/gold ranks 1-9) and a fresh semiconductor/hardware surge (Semi Equipment 124->3 in 5 days). Oil eased despite a closed Strait of Hormuz.
